name: patch_and_scan
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,os,re
LANE=os.getcwd()
w=os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py')
s=open('sources/2207.04831.txt',encoding='utf-8').read()
unread=s[25431:43419]+s[57900:]
print('unread chars',len(unread))
for pat in ['Conjecture 4','sqrt','√','Θ','novel','future','open']:
    locs=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(pat,unread)]
    print(pat,len(locs))
for m in list(re.finditer('Conjecture 4|√|Θ',unread))[:12]:
    print('..',unread[max(0,m.start()-160):m.start()+200].replace('\n',' '))
print('=== tail of paper before refs')
i=s.find('References',57900)
print(s[max(0,i-1800):i])
f=open('FULLCANDIDATE.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
old1='and qt_0 if x is missing'
new1='and q*tau_0 if x is missing'
assert f.count(old1)==1
f=f.replace(old1,new1)
old2="the Involve final of 2207.04831 was not read (arXiv v2 read: pp. 1-15 and Sections 1-3 up to Corollary 16's start; the rest of Section 3 was not read)."
new2="the Involve final of 2207.04831 was not read. Of its arXiv v2 extracted text (96141 characters) I read characters 0-25431 (introduction, Lemma 5, Lemma 6 and its proof) and 43419-57900 (Lemma 15, its proof, the start of Corollary 16); characters 25431-43419 and 57900-end, which include the proofs of Theorem 7 and Theorem 9, were only pattern-scanned for sqrt, Conjecture 4 and Theta mentions."
assert f.count(old2)==1
f=f.replace(old2,new2)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'FULLCANDIDATE.md'],input=f,text=True,capture_output=True);print('w',r.returncode,r.stderr)
